policy: Mappings target one stable source sense and one verified opaque Artsy gene ID. They create review candidates only; names and glosses are display text, never identity.

mappings.mapping_review_basis: Exact Artsy gene resource and exact Open English WordNet source sense were verified; semantic use remains related and requires per-artwork review.
mappings.note: Conflict is related subject vocabulary. It does not establish that a work illustrates armed warfare; a reviewer must inspect the depicted event.
